Hi Priya — great to connect.

On Mon, 28 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Priya Natarajan <priya@heliohealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week. The steering committee asked me to surface a clear cost/term comparison for the monitoring add-ons we discussed...

Attached is a compact summary (pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx) with three commercial options that map to the needs you called out:
1) Flex (monthly, pay-as-you-go): standard retention (30d), tracing billed per ingestion GB, no discounting.
2) Commit (12m prepaid): 30% reduction on per-GB storage for traces + 10% off dashboard-plus seats; includes 5k monitoring credits for the first quarter.
3) Enterprise Retain (annual or multi-year): configurable retention buckets (30/90/365), lower per-GB rates, priority routing for trace ingestion, and deeper dashboard customization.

Quick notes on SLAs: we can commit to 99.9% trace ingestion availability for the Enterprise Retain tier and provide audit logs for retention operations. We can outline higher SLAs as part of a dedicated capacity/Private deployment conversation.

Next steps I propose:
- You review the attached matrix with the steering committee (today if possible).
- If pricing is acceptable, we can scope an 18-month commercial that gives you a larger upfront credit pool.
- Schedule a 30-min call to walk execs through the numbers — Ben (copied) can join to answer margin/discount questions.

Let me know what time works.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Thanks Jasmine — received and shared. A few quick questions from the execs:
- Retention cost: moving from 30d to 90d increases our expected storage spend by ~3x. Can you give us an example P&L for a 10 TB/month ingestion profile with the Commit vs Enterprise Retain tiers?
- Discount ask: given this is a platform-level purchase (monitoring plus tracing across multiple product teams), would Redwood consider a 30% first-year concession if we commit to 24 months and a minimum monthly usage guarantee?
- Dashboards PoC: will you include a short PoC for advanced dashboards (3 views + drilldowns) as part of the eval?

If you can get answers by EOD tomorrow it will help for the July 1 meeting.

Priya

Jasmine/LAuren — looping in pricing guidance so we can respond to Priya's asks.

Recommendation (quick):
- Offer a structured counter: 20% first-year discount for a 12-month prepaid Commit; 25% first-year for an 18-month commit with a minimum monthly usage clause. We should avoid 24-month heavy concessions unless we see strategic value (logo or larger ACV).
- Include 10,000 monitoring credits applied as billing credits over the first 90 days to smooth initial storage/burst costs (helps their P&L).
- Provide a sample 10 TB/month cost model (will attach trace-usage-sample.csv).
- Deliver a dashboard PoC as part of the sales process (no additional charge) — scope: 3 dashboards, 2 saved queries, one drilldown.

I've redlined the SOW to clarify retention tiers, SLA language, and termination triggers (see redlined_SOW.pdf). Jasmine — if you can accept the 25%/18m offer and include the credit pool I'm happy to approve on behalf of Sales; otherwise pricing committee wants justification for deeper discounts.

Hi Priya / Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround. Following internal review, here is a concise commercial proposal that addresses your asks and the steering committee priorities.

Summary offer (final):
- Term: 18 months
- First-year concession: 25% off add-on list pricing applied to retention and tracing per-GB rates for year 1 of the term.
- Ongoing pricing: year 2 at 12% off list (for the remainder of the term where applicable).
- Credits: 10,000 monitoring credits applied as billing credits pro-rated over the first 90 days (to offset ingestion spikes).
- SLAs: 99.9% trace ingestion availability for Enterprise Retain feature set; retention guarantees as specified in the attached SOW.
- PoC: included at no additional charge — scope as Ben outlined (3 dashboards, saved queries, drilldown).

Retention tiers (operational):
- Standard: 30 days (default)
- Extended: 90 days (archive storage pricing applies)
- Long-term: 365 days (available as part of Enterprise Retain with negotiated bucket pricing)
